about_the_game:
Open your humble food stand in a lively Algerian neighborhood and begin your journey into the world of traditional street food!

In Gargouti Simulator, you play as the owner of a small local food shop deep in the heart of an authentic Algerian neighborhood. Your mission? Cook up beloved street dishes like Karantika, French fry sandwiches, and omelettes — all while dealing with quirky customers, tight timing, and the chaotic charm of everyday life.

This isn’t just a cooking game — it’s an immersive slice-of-life experience where you’ll explore Algerian food culture, manage your shop, and climb your way to becoming the true King of the Gargouti.

🧾 Key Features:

  • 🏘️ Authentic Algerian atmosphere: Inspired by real neighborhoods, with local signs, decor, and casual street vibes.

  • 🍴 Discover traditional food: Prepare Karantika, French fry sandwiches, omelettes, and more!

  • 😂 Quirky customer interactions: Get praised — or roasted — based on your performance.

  • 🛠️ Realistic tools and appliances: Use grills, spatulas, gas stoves, soda fridges, and sauce bottles.

  • 🎶 Local music and sound design: Adds a vibrant and immersive Algerian flavor.

    Can you keep up with the rush, satisfy your customers, and make your little shop the pride of the neighborhood?

    Test your skills and experience the everyday flavor of Algerian street life in Gargouti Simulator!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4130 or AMD Athlon X4 860K
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 530 or NVIDIA GT 730 (DDR5), or AMD R7 250
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Graphics API : OpenGL 4.3+ or Vulkan 1.2+
